Arthur Dales is my brother. My name also happens to be Arthur Dales. It's the same name, different guy. The other Arthur, he moved to florida, the lucky bastard. Our parents weren't exactly big in the imagination department when it came to names. Arthur Dales

My brother told me all about you. He said you were the biggest jackass in the bureau since he retired. Yeah, we're big fans. Sometimes we'd stay awake for hours at night just talking about you. Just fascinating. Now, unless you're hiding some chinese food, let's call it a day.

Fox Mulder

Mr. Dales, I have a, uh-- I have a photo here of your brother. Maybe it's you. It's from many years ago, and you're standing in Roswell, New Mexico.

Arthur Dales

Roswell. That's me. I was a cop once in Roswell.

Fox Mulder

Okay. And you're standing with negro league legend Josh Exley, who disappeared without a trace during a season in which he hit 60 home runs.

Arthur Dales

Sixty-one! Sixty-one

Fox Mulder

Home runs in 1948.

Arthur Dales

Forty-seven. Forty-seven,

Fox Mulder

Whatever. I don't really care about the baseball so much. What I care about is this man in the picture with you... I believe to be an alien bounty hunter.

Arthur Dales

Of course you don't care about the baseball, mr. Mulder. You only bothered my brother about the important things... Like government conspiracies and alien bounty hunters... And the truth with a capital "t."

Fox Mulder

Wait a minute. I like baseball.

Arthur Dales

You like baseball, huh?

Fox Mulder

Yeah.

Arthur Dales

How many home runs did mickey mantle hit?

Fox Mulder

A hundred and sixty-three. [ scoffs ] righty, 373 lefty, 536 total.

Arthur Dales

What you fail to understand in your joyless myopia... Is that baseball is the key to life. The rosetta stone, if you will. If you just understood baseball better, all your other questions, your-- the aliens, the conspiracies-- they would all in their way be answered by the baseball gods.

Fox Mulder

Yes, sir. That may be true. I'm thinking that your experience in Roswell... Could be germane to a conspiracy between our government and these shape-shifting alien beings.

Arthur Dales

Oh, don't bore me, son. My brother Arthur started the X-Files, the federal bureau of obfuscation, before you were born. He was working for the FBI, hunting for aliens... When you were watching my best friend's martians. You say "shape-shifting." agent Mulder, do you believe... That love can make a man shape-shift?

[ chuckles ]

Fox Mulder

I guess women change men all the time.

Arthur Dales

I'm not talking about women. I'm talking about love, passion. Like the passion you have for proving extraterrestrial life. Do you believe that that passion can change your very nature? Can make you shape-shift from a man into something other than a man?

Fox Mulder

What exactly has your brother told you about me? Mr. Dales, if you and your brother have really known about this bounty hunter... And plans for colonization for 50 years, why the hell wouldn't you have told anybody?

Arthur Dales

Fox Mulder

I would have believed you.

Arthur Dales

No. You weren't ripe.

Fox Mulder

Not ripe? Let me tell you something. I've been ripe for years. I am way past ripe. I'm so ripe, I'm rotten. This cuts to the very heart of the mystery of what I've been doing for the past ten years.

Arthur Dales

Oh, the heart of the mystery! The heart of the mystery! Ah, there you are! Mr. Mulder, maybe you'd better start paying... A little less attention to the heart of the mystery... And a little more attention to the mystery of the heart. You got a dime?

Fox Mulder

What is this?

Arthur Dales

This little fella goes by the name of pete rosebud. If you keep pumping coffee money into him, he'll tell you a story... About baseball and aliens and bounty hunters.

Fox Mulder

Arthur Dales
